- **Skip heavy, thick-skinned reds:** Cabernet Sauvignon, Nebbiolo, Petit Sirah, and Tannat typically have much firmer, more drying tannins.⁠Wine Folly  +4[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX9EdP3NXJL9soY_MDTPmIanbKviM0PhhTX6VTNv-CWz4i1LxyVnJ8bPXNbNuCXGhRqAWJsZQJfqhx4xVRlGXCXeneVWQ8x-t8mYneMe3gDlfjsL6sbdAFBgfziAfyYwxuLCK3L2B7)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXof_oIbtNbB5AWbhdrn2IJFLL7NvWjTGqTYb7lSfmPEZAtgmM7jIy5mHl4OjEMKtM2zZDKdEGd30rVXkXV8IWHKLN2STdlW9pGRf_kMVQbSnFzGTj4_gy_k6DbMdQO1TQnB209LkpUDHkqn1mXbM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXiGCbqj5leBuMnvf2ej-g-zZCz1uNCt0VRIUs_p1vGhS_akK4ypzRr7cSXpnMQ8Y0rKcmKu9zJD0ScE5ClWUSzeS-DNKmDt6sR0cEFZTzN1wNXbprN26oC4bQBuMFoM9iafr7pRDX3I0R3b5VOc4)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXDXEDmBTKHJfbrdYq4EuTqq2pm88uhJrM-QvWcX4ViMkcbfHGi3cjQdpzEfTU-NbiCQ8V_nEeDktA3SCxH-ex-REeSYbgK0pW_EvrL0vAw16bO805Zsh45IKZ-XmvhEFO-aFZQMBd)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1wAlogSkJlWIbh3vm8LI7QRLmr3SNwjX2Cncr7NsvGg1uDRwXKlCViHgfMjLHd3qC0FGmlbgGBxzhPRVcjTeYsTGhzLWueLvRca23bPPAm_tNkI_uPs-lf-FJY7MesR78-yWXYAGco37DkfdPFYCyjj0jM99CQQ7UpvGhh4HdA)
